fact_check_verdict: Primary sources independently re-fetched. Fourteen meaningful propositions: twelve already voiced and two source-backed replacement lines. Publish as TCC's announced terms, not audited performance or universal rollout. The two added facts count only after their replacement narration is present and measured.

claims.spoken: On September 2nd, Tanana Chiefs Conference announced it is introducing Sully.ai.
requires: Announcement only; no rollout count, complete deployment or measured benefits.
No recording without permission; do not imply passive surveillance.

claims.spoken: The provider reviews, edits as needed, and approves before the note reaches the medical record.
requires: The tool does not diagnose, recommend treatments or make medical decisions.

claims.spoken: TCC says recordings are deleted after ninety days.
requires: Attributed policy, not independent audit. Applies to recordings, not chart notes or derived data.

claims.spoken: The technology company may use de-identified portions of encounter recordings to improve the system.
requires: Do not claim all recordings are reused; no verified retention period for derivatives or separate opt-out mechanism.

claims.spoken: TCC says declining won't affect the care you receive.
requires: Do not invent consent revocation mechanics, retrospective deletion or actual patient sentiment.

claims.spoken: The aim is less typing and more attention for patients.
requires: Stated aim, not measured outcome; do not assert accuracy, reduced burnout or time savings.

claims.spoken: Tanana Chiefs Conference is an Interior Alaska tribal health organization.
claims.evidence_locator: Institutional introduction, healthcare remit, mission and regional description.
claims.density_origin: f01, already voiced at line 1; one institutional identity, not separate adjective claims.
requires: Institutional context only. No organization geography or membership count establishes Sully deployment coverage.

claims.spoken: The tool listens during the appointment and creates a draft note.
claims.evidence_locator: Tool-definition paragraph describing the documentation transformation.
claims.density_origin: f05, already voiced at line 3; separated from c2's permission requirement because function and authorization are different propositions.
requires: Listening and draft creation are one mechanism fact, not two. Permission must precede recording; provider approval precedes chart inclusion.

claims.spoken: Sully does not make medical decisions.
claims.evidence_locator: Clinical-role exclusion immediately after the provider-review paragraph.
claims.density_origin: f07, already voiced at line 5; authority boundary distinct from c3's note-approval workflow.
requires: Clinical-scope restriction, not a claim of accurate diagnosis. Provider review, editing, approval and chart entry remain one c3 fact.

claims.spoken: TCC says patients can change their minds about using Sully.ai.
claims.evidence_locator: Patient-choice paragraph, sentence following the refusal instruction.
claims.density_origin: f10, already voiced at line 15; later withdrawal differs from initial consent and the separate no-care-penalty promise.
requires: No invented withdrawal interface, retrospective deletion, undoing prior reuse or separate reuse opt-out. Initial refusal is not another fact beyond c2.

claims.spoken: This notice reports no measured benefits.
claims.evidence_locator: Full article independently read; benefit assertions contain no outcome measurements or evaluation results.
claims.density_origin: f12, already voiced at line 12; one evidence-status finding distinct from c7's announced aim.
requires: Limit the absence claim to this notice. Do not claim the tool never works or that no research exists elsewhere. Repeated audit caveats do not add density facts.

claims.on_screen: TCC SAYS · RECORDING STORAGE FOLLOWS HIPAA
claims.spoken: TCC says recording storage follows HIPAA privacy rules.
claims.evidence_locator: First privacy paragraph assigns secure storage and HIPAA protection to recordings, separately from the retention deadline.
claims.density_origin: New meaningful privacy-protection assertion for replacement line 9; not yet voiced in the pre-rewrite inventory.
requires: Explicitly attribute to TCC and scope to recordings, not reused deidentified portions. Not a compliance audit, security guarantee or proof of anonymity. Treat the linked security/HIPAA assurances as one fact.

claims.spoken: To decline recording, tell your provider.
claims.evidence_locator: Patient-choice paragraph tells patients who prefer no recording to inform their provider.
claims.density_origin: New meaningful procedural channel for replacement line 14; not a duplicate assertion that refusal is permitted.
requires: The concrete refusal channel is the provider. Do not invent forms, portals, physical switch controls, separate reuse opt-out or retrospective deletion.
